overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated spinach flakes in India from carefully selected fresh spinach leaves. Our controlled drying process reduces moisture while locking in natural green color, savory leafy aroma, and vegetable profile. Sized at approximately 3-8 mm, these uniform flakes offer food processors a shelf-stable, dependable alternative to fresh produce, eliminating washing, trimming labor, and seasonal supply fluctuations.

As an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain a structured six-step processing framework from sourcing to dispatch. Our dehydrated spinach flakes integrate directly into dry formulations or rehydrate smoothly in wet recipes. We support international manufacturers, seasoning blenders, and private label brands with consistent bulk supply, export documentation, and custom mesh or packaging configurations.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated spinach flakes?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, supporting both initial product development trials and full commercial bulk shipments.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom mesh sizes or fine spinach powder?
faqs.a: Yes. While our standard flakes measure approximately 3 to 8 mm, we supply custom cuts and fine 80 mesh powder upon specification.

faqs.q: Do you offer private label and custom packaging services?
faqs.a: Yes. We accommodate OEM and private label requirements using small retail pouches, jars, or customized bulk cartons based on your specifications.

faqs.q: Can buyers request product samples prior to placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes. Product samples are available on request to help you evaluate color, aroma, particle distribution, and application performance.

faqs.q: What are the recommended storage conditions and shelf life?
faqs.a: The product maintains a 12-month shelf life when stored in sealed, moisture-proof packaging in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

faqs.q: What manufacturing and export credentials back your supply chain?
faqs.a: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter in India, providing structured batch traceability and full export documentation support.
